label: LEAP
statement: A synaptic-selective GABA-A positive modulator RAISES the spontaneous burst rate of Wwox neuron-knockout neocortical slices at P13-P17 by at least 25% of the slice's own baseline in at least two thirds of slices, beyond time-matched vehicle drift.
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: Burst rate before and after the GABA-A arm in KO neocortex slices (EXPERIMENT_BRIEF.md step 3), against vehicle; animals as the unit.
dated_outcome_source: The L7 first run report (laboratory report date to be recorded at registration; no earlier event exists).
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: increase. Class: GABA-A positive modulators (synaptic-selective) and benzodiazepines become aggravation in the matrix.
trivial_baseline: No effect (matrix expectation is a decrease, so 'no effect or decrease' is the trivial baseline).
rejecting_result: Burst rate falls, or changes by less than vehicle drift, in KO slices.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Rise: GABA-A rows turn to aggravation and the seizure P13-P15 top set moves to the pore blockers alone (L7 scenario S8, 1 of 15). Fall: HSCI-2 rejected; the five-way tie is unchanged.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

label: LEAP
statement: The NAM-sensitive fraction of the isolated NMDAR current in Wwox-null pyramidal cells at P13-P17 is at least 40%, while the matched wild-type fraction lies inside the Mierau 2004 interval 0-34%.
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: WO-10 with a genotype contrast: fraction of the isolated NMDAR current removed by a GluN2B NAM at a verified block, KO against WT, same age and region, animals as the unit.
dated_outcome_source: The WO-10 report (first measurement of the brief).
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: higher fraction in KO. Class: GluN2B NAMs gain directness.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Fraction >= 40%: GluN2B NAM directness rises and, with a specific burst effect, the NAM class alone leads (L7 scenario S4). Inside 0-34%: NAM class falls back; pore blockers and AMPA remain.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

origin: the Aldaz question (brief, LEAP file HSCI-5 context)
label: LINEAR
statement: Neocortical layer 2/3 PV+ interneuron density is reduced by at least 30% in Synapsin-Cre Wwox knockout against wild-type littermates at P13-P17 (as PV+ cells are reduced in the hippocampus of the full-knockout line, Aldaz 2019).
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: PV+ and NPY+ cell counts by stereology in neocortical L2/3 and hippocampus, the same animals and sections as the slice experiment.
dated_outcome_source: The Aldaz-measurement report of the brief (step 5).
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: reduction in neocortex. Class: GABA-A positive modulators, benzodiazepines, GABA-AT/GAT (the PV signal counts as a match).
trivial_baseline: No reduction (as in the P47T line, where Pvalb is unchanged).
rejecting_result: Reduction below 15% or an interval that includes zero in neocortex.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Reduction in neocortex: T18 accepted as a match and the P13-P15 top set shrinks from 5 to 2 (GABA-A PAM, benzodiazepines; scratch run PRESIDIO-012). No reduction: T18 stays unknown; top set stays 5.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

label: LEAP
statement: Burst incidence in KO slices falls to 50% of baseline or less at 40% or less of the NMDAR current removed (a steep, threshold-like curve), not along the linear diagonal.
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: d-APV titration with the isolated NMDAR current measured in the same slices (INV-05 X2).
dated_outcome_source: The WO-10 plus titration report of the brief.
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: steep curve. Class: GluN2B NAMs become viable if the critical fraction is at or below the NAM-sensitive share.
rejecting_result: Burst incidence still at or above 70% of baseline at 40% removed.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Steep and f_c within the NAM share: NAM class gains (S4 pattern). Graded: NAM class falls; pore blockers and AMPA classes remain.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

label: LEAP
statement: In KO neocortical L2/3 pyramidal cells E_GABA is at least 5 mV more depolarised at burst end than at burst onset, and this shift is larger than in matched wild-type provoked bursts.
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: Gramicidin-perforated-patch E_GABA (or a chloride sensor) at burst onset and burst end in the same cells.
dated_outcome_source: The perforated-patch report added to the pilot animals (brief, Addendum 2).
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: depolarising shift. Class: chloride-gradient modulators (watch class) gain; GABA-A positive modulators lose.
rejecting_result: Shift under 2 mV or equal to the wild-type shift.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Shift: AH3 becomes a prediction, GABA-A rows lose the top set and the chloride class earns a column (trigger met). No shift: GABA-A rows keep their rank.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

label: LEAP
statement: A GAT-1/GAT-3 blocker raises the tonic GABA-A current of KO slices by at least twice as much as in a neuron-enriched culture of the same genotype (glial-compartment dependence).
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: Gabazine-sensitive tonic current under a GAT blocker, KO slice against KO neuron-enriched culture.
dated_outcome_source: A tonic-current report (the readout added to the GABA-A arm, brief step 3).
predicted_direction_and_class: Direction: larger in slices. Class: GABA-AT/GAT inhibitors move from the GABA-A thread to the glial thread.
rejecting_result: Response in the neuron-enriched culture at least 50% of the slice response.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: Glial dependence: the GABA-AT/GAT cell moves to the glial (neuroinflammation) thread and is rescored; top set may lose or keep it.
expiry_if_no_event: 2027-11-16 (then recorded as unscorable by expiry, not as failed)

label: LINEAR

label: LINEAR
statement: Any Wwox-deficient neocortical slice electrophysiology paper from a laboratory outside the Aqeilan-Carlen network that appears by the expiry will report spontaneous neocortical bursts in the knockout (and none in the hippocampus), replicating Breton 2021.

dated_outcome_source: The same two-route query, re-run on the expiry date; the hit list is recorded.

trivial_baseline: No such paper appears (zero found before 2026-11-16 by two routes): the null is the base rate.
rejecting_result: A second-laboratory paper that reports no bursts in KO neocortex.
matrix_top_set_it_would_change: A replicated origin would break the single-origin collapse (origin-collapsed and per-thread rankings would stop differing).

label: LEAP
statement: In a newly reported Wwox child on a neuron-target agent (sodium-channel blocker or GABA-A modulator) with both endpoints stated, seizure and developmental outcomes agree (both improve or both do not) more often than for children on a glial-target class (GABA-AT inhibitor, corticosteroid/ACTH).
event_or_measurement_that_settles_it: A new case report or series with at least 3 children per group and both endpoints stated per agent.
dated_outcome_source: A PubMed query (WWOX AND case report AND the agent classes) re-run at the expiry date.
